info.name: Remove a Job from Redundant Group

params.name: redundant_group_id
params.description: Redundant group ID

params.name: job_id
params.description: Live job ID

params.name: force
params.description:
The `force` parameter serves different purposes for different requests: 
1. For [force failover requests](#operation/ForceRedundantStreamFailover): force failover for a redundant stream without going to manual mode
2. For [remove job from redundant group requests](#operation/RemoveJobRedundantGroup): force removal of on-air job
3. For [delete redundant group requests](#operation/DeleteRedundantGroup): force delete redundant group in processing state

Note that `force` is a string, not a boolean. The value must be `true`, not `1`.
